summary: Capital One Financial Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a proposed offering of fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2032 and 2037. The notes are unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing unsecured debt, issued in minimum denominations of EUR100,000. Interest terms include fixed rates followed by floating rates based on three-month EURIBOR. The company may redeem the notes at its option one year before maturity or upon tax events. No special-situation event is involved; this is a routine debt securities offering.
